label: Open price
gloss: the bar's open price

label: High price
gloss: the bar's high price

label: Low price
gloss: the bar's low price

label: Close price
gloss: the bar's close price

label: Last price
gloss: the last traded price, read live at report build time — not a bar close

label: Mark price
gloss: the perpetual mark price — live on display, the decided bar's market-stats sample under a decision — not a bar close

label: Oracle price
gloss: the oracle (index) price from the mark's own frame — live on display, the decided bar's market-stats sample under a decision — not a bar close

label: Spot close (Coinbase)
gloss: Coinbase spot close of the bar's period, quoted in USD (USDC where no USD product exists), expressed in this coin's own unit (a k-prefixed ticker such as kPEPE denotes 1000 base tokens, and the venue price is scaled to match so it compares with the mark): Coinbase's last trade in the period, or the price it carried through every minute of a period with no trade; absent where any minute of the period went unseen (missed by Coinbase's feed and not recovered from its trade history), or where the coin did not trade on Coinbase in the period and its price was not carried through every minute of it (its last trade older than the coin's spot-tape freshness target, at least 15 minutes, or the minute before the period unpriced); a forming bar's close older than that target is absent

label: Deviation from par
gloss: a stablecoin pair's deviation from its declared par, ((close − par) / par) × 100, signed, on a section bound to a declared reference pair, read off the pair's own spot tape; its history is seeded at boot from the pair's venue candles, so a lookback beyond the history the store holds reads absent

label: Spot close (Binance)
gloss: Binance spot close of the bar's period, USDT-quoted, expressed in this coin's own unit (a k-prefixed ticker such as kPEPE denotes 1000 base tokens, and the venue price is scaled to match so it compares with the mark): Binance's last trade in the period, or the price it carried through every minute of a period with no trade; absent where any minute of the period went unseen (missed by Binance's feed and not recovered from its trade history), or where the coin did not trade on Binance in the period and its price was not carried through every minute of it (its last trade older than the coin's spot-tape freshness target, at least 15 minutes, or the minute before the period unpriced); a forming bar's close older than that target is absent

label: Bar state
gloss: whether the bar is still forming (live, provisional) or already closed

label: UTC hour
gloss: the hour of the UTC day the bar opened in, 0 to 23 — a fact of the bar's open time, never of when it is read

label: UTC weekday
gloss: the UTC weekday the bar opened on, as the index 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday — a fact of the bar's open time; a weekend is DAY_OF_WEEK outside 1 to 5

label: Trading session
gloss: the trading session the bar opened in, fixed in UTC with no daylight-saving rule: asia (Asia 00–08 UTC), london (London 08–13 UTC), newYork (New York 13–21 UTC), late (Late 21–24 UTC) — a fact of the bar's open time

label: Doji
gloss: whether the bar is a doji: its body is at most 0.1× the mean range of the 10 bars before it (TA-Lib CDLDOJI)

label: Pin bar
gloss: a pin bar by shape alone, with no trend context: lower_wick when the body is under the mean body of the 10 bars before it, the lower wick is longer than the body and than the upper wick, and the upper wick is under 0.1× their mean range (TA-Lib's hammer shape); upper_wick mirrors it (the shooting-star shape)

label: Engulfing
gloss: whether the bar's body engulfs the prior bar's opposite-colour body, one equal edge allowed (TA-Lib CDLENGULFING): bullish for a white bar over a black one, bearish for the mirror, with no trend context

label: Inside / outside bar
gloss: the bar's range against the prior bar's: inside when its high is lower and its low higher, outside when its high is higher and its low lower

label: Close location
gloss: where the bar closed within its own range, (close − low) / (high − low) — 0 at the low, 1 at the high; no value on a bar whose high equals its low

label: Gap
gloss: whether the bar opened outside the prior bar's range: up above its high, down below its low

label: Gap (range clear)
gloss: whether the bar's whole range cleared the prior bar's, TradingView's Gap Detector rule: up when its low is above the prior high, down when its high is below the prior low

label: Gap %
gloss: the gap from the prior bar's close to this bar's open, ((open − prior close) / prior close) × 100

label: Close run
gloss: consecutive closes in one direction ending at this bar, signed: +n when the last n closes each closed above their prior close, −n below, 0 when the close equals the prior close; capped at ±20

label: Candle run
gloss: consecutive candles of this bar's colour ending at this bar, signed: +n white (close at or above open), −n black; capped at ±20

label: Median price (HL2)
gloss: the bar's median price, (high + low) / 2

label: Typical price (HLC3)
gloss: the bar's typical price, (high + low + close) / 3

label: Average price (OHLC4)
gloss: the bar's average price, (open + high + low + close) / 4

label: RSI (14)
gloss: 14-period relative strength index (0–100)

label: RSI (7)
gloss: 7-period relative strength index (0–100)

label: RSI (2)
gloss: 2-period relative strength index (0–100) — the Connors mean-reversion horizon
